verdict.rationale: Gecko is a SaaS security platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at /docs/ai-tools/overview, and the docs say a connected AI tool can list repos and scans, pull full vulnerability evidence (PoC, call chain, patch diff), triage findings, and file tickets. Missing for 10: setup and auth details (transport, client configuration, API-key scoping for MCP), a published tool list beyond the summary line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
